description: This file defines the `ShoppingCart` entity class, which models a shopping cart in the application. It includes fields such as `id`, `shoppingCartCode`, `lineItems` (a set of `ShoppingCartItem`s), associated `merchantStore`, and `customerId`. The class uses JPA and Hibernate annotations for ORM mapping, manages audit information, and includes methods for accessing and modifying its properties.

classes.name: ShoppingCart
classes.description: Entity class representing a shopping cart, containing information such as cart ID, code, line items, associated merchant store, and customer ID. Implements auditing via `Auditable` and extends generic entity `SalesManagerEntity`.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section containing audit metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the shopping cart.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the shopping cart.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Indicates whether the cart is obsolete.

methods.name: setObsolete
methods.description: Sets the obsolete status of the cart.

methods.name: getLineItems
methods.description: Returns the set of line items in the shopping cart.

methods.name: setLineItems
methods.description: Sets the line items in the shopping cart.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with the cart.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the cart.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the cart.
